questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: A reminder is scheduled for 8 seconds after Start. What triggers its handler?
answers: The timer reaching the scheduled delay
questions.explanation: The timer event is tied to elapsed time after scheduling.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: An animation updates every 0.5 seconds. How many updates occur at 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, and 2.0 seconds?
questions.explanation: The four listed update times each cause one update.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: A scheduled warning should not appear after Cancel. What should Cancel do?
questions.explanation: Removing the pending timer prevents that delayed action from firing.

questions.subject: Programming skills · Events
questions.text: Why avoid assuming that a browser timer fires at an exact real-world instant?
answers: Other work can delay the callback
The user's name determines the delay
questions.explanation: Busy execution can postpone a scheduled callback.
